about_the_game:
Embark on a mystical journey to Eldramoor: Haven in the Mist, and find your home away from home! Follow in the footsteps of the legendary hero Eldranis. Fight for the people, master diverse professions and socialize in the local tavern with fun mini-games. In Eldramoor, everyone is accepted for who they are. But a darkness, long locked away, has come creeping back. Uncover the land’s troubled history and defend the island from an ancient force that threatens to destroy everything in its path. 

A Massively Multiplayer World

Eldramoor is vast and full of unique environments to experience. The game world features five distinct zones—each with a wildly different biome—full of inhabitants to meet, treasures to loot, and challenges to conquer. Exploration is rewarded, and staying on the beaten path will miss half the fun, so be sure to leave no stone unturned as you run, climb and glide your way across the island.

Social Experience

At its core, Eldramoor is a social game designed around multiplayer interactions. With guilds, dungeons, PvP, and special events, there’s always something to do with your friends. Add in all the little experiences like multiplayer profession “trains”, player-to-player trade, and stacking powerups with the open-world bonfire system, you’ll quickly see why Eldramoor thrives on real interactions between real players.

Combat Freedom

In Eldramoor, you build your class your way. Choose from a huge list of skills, each of which scale in a multitude of ways. If you want to cast a fireball the size of a house, this is the place to do it. If you want that fireball to explode into a rain of burning embers, that’s another route you could take.

And if that fireball doesn’t suit the fight, change your class on the fly. Each character can level every class, and gear isn’t class-locked, so nothing is stopping you from playing a mage in full plate then swapping to a robe-wearing warrior. This is your world, so play your way!

Self-Expression

Expressing yourself is part of the human experience, and VR provides an incredible medium for doing so. Eldramoor takes full advantage of this by providing body options, outfits, and accessories—none of which are gender-locked—so you can truly be yourself, or whomever you want to be! And you won’t be alone. Our cast of characters is just as unique as you are.

Accessibility

Eldramoor is a bold take on accessibility in a medium and genre that can be inaccessible to many. Robust comfort settings ensure that everyone can move, fight, and play regardless of motion sickness, colorblindness, or sound sensitivity. Intuitive gameplay motions and a guided new player experience ensure that no matter how familiar you are with MMOs, RPGs, or VR, you’ll be able to pick up a controller and play. 

Choose Your Challenge

Playing your way is as much about difficulty as it is about freeform builds and diverse character options. Eldramoor is designed to offer plenty of gameplay at different challenge levels so that players can take on whatever they find fun. If you’re a hardcore raider, hop into our endgame dungeons; we’ll put you to the test. If you don’t know what that sentence means, explore the open world.

 It’s full of rare monsters to tackle and treasures to find. If none of that appeals to you, hit the crafting bench. The recipes have a full range of difficulty, too! Whatever your mood, there’s something for you to do in Eldramoor.

Story 

Eldramoor was born when a ship of refugees, fleeing persecution, was blown off course by a storm and washed ashore on a mysterious island. Exhausted and alone, the travelers established the settlement of Eldramoor in the wild and seemingly abandoned territory they found. Over time, explorers mapped the nearby regions, each bound by powerful leylines that influence both terrain and creatures.

A land of blistering heat and rolling dunes, Arinod is the homeland of the competitive, vibrant Sauravi. Fertile with mushrooms as tall as the sky, Zobu brims with colossal flora and fauna as well as the resilient Bunfolk. Both stunningly beautiful and unimaginably dangerous, Glacera’s high peaks weed out all but the toughest. And Torcia, whose twisted landscape and warped creatures are haunted by a terrifying past.

From mountains to mushroom forests, each realm reveals its own trials and mysteries, calling brave adventurers to uncover all that Eldramoor has to offer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-6700k
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR

short_description: Gather your friends—or make new ones—as you forge your destiny in Eldramoor, a bold new VR MMO. Master your crafting abilities, level up your combat skills, explore five unique regions, or just socialize at the local tavern. Whatever you bring to the community, you have a home in Eldramoor.
